shared_elements: human figures in strict profile with elaborate curled/patterned beard and hair
animals or animal features rendered with patterned, repeated incised texture (fleece, feathers)
a border/register band bounding the scene
stylized floral/rosette motifs in a border or field
justification: Both are shallow relief scenes of profile figures with the same conventions: elaborately curled beards and hair rendered as regular incised curls, garments with patterned fringes, texture conveyed by rows of repeated scale-like marks (fleece in A, feathers in B), and a plant/rosette motif bounding or filling the field. But the actual subjects differ: A is a horizontal procession of attendants leading two horned rams past a tree, while B is a single frontally-composed bird-headed winged figure holding a bucket and raising a cone amid stylized flowering plants beneath a block of writing.
